description: QEF certification thresholds for professional services deployments.

G1_ContextAssembly.rationale: Context must accurately reflect project, finance, and pipeline data.

G2_DecisionQuality.rationale: WAANDA decisions must be traceable to evidence before L3 approval.

G3_PlanningAccuracy.rationale: Workflow plans must match execution within acceptable variance.

G4_ExecutionReliability.rationale: Approved workflows must complete without failure >85% of the time.

G5_WorkflowCanvas.rationale: Canvas must render all 9 seeded workflows correctly.

G6_RealTimeIntelligence.rationale: Signals must surface within 60s of triggering events.

G7_ReleaseGovernance.rationale: All deployments must pass RGS pre-flight before production.

G8_OIS.rationale: Minimum OIS of 60/100 before Customer Zero Report is considered credible.
